name: Chase lead that went quiet for 2 days
description: In a marketing agency: inbound leads from the website form have had no update for more than 2 days, and nobody has followed up, so the problem surfaces only when it is urgent. This workflow every lead older than 2 days is routed to the right person with a ready-to-send message.

parameters.content:
HOW IT WORKS

Chase lead that went quiet for 2 days. Every lead older than 2 days is routed to the right person with a ready-to-send message.

The run follows this order:
1. Days since the last update
2. Mark rows older than 2 days
3. Build the message
4. Email the contact

Rows are de-duplicated on record_id before anything is sent, and rows whose status is already terminal are skipped, so a second run never sends the same message twice.

SETUP

1. Open the CONFIG node and replace every {{PLACEHOLDER}} value.
2. Fill: SHEET_ID, SHEET_NAME, SENDER_EMAIL, ALERT_CHANNEL.
3. Attach these credentials: gmailOAuth2.
4. Enable the nodes marked DISABLED once their credential is attached.
5. Run once with CONFIG.test_mode = 'normal' and check the output.
6. Activate the workflow.
Reads the source rows, removes duplicates, then applies the decision rules. Nothing leaves this section.
Only rows where needs_action is true continue. Everything else leaves through the false output.
Builds the message and performs the action. A failed delivery is logged instead of silently dropped.

nodes.name: Read Source Rows
nodes.notes: DISABLED until you attach your own credential in n8n. Select the credential, then enable this node. See README > Nodes disabled until you attach credentials.

nodes.name: De-duplicate Rows
nodes.notes: Removes duplicate record_id rows before any message is built, so one row can never produce two messages.

nodes.name: Days since the last update
nodes.notes: Hari sejak kolom tanggal, lalu tandai lewat batas.

nodes.name: Build the message
nodes.notes: Gabungkan template subjek/badan dengan token baris.

nodes.name: Email the contact
nodes.notes: DISABLED until you attach your own credential in n8n. Select the credential, then enable this node. See README > Nodes disabled until you attach credentials.

nodes.name: Normalize Payload
nodes.notes: Runs on the first node that carries the rows the decision depends on. CONFIG sits between the trigger and the data and replaces the payload with configuration, so normalising at the trigger would normalise data that is then discarded.

nodes.name: Build Run Receipt
nodes.notes: Run receipt. Fans out to 2 destinations: the Run Log tab, plus any notification channel needed to reach three services. n8n runs these branches one after another, not in parallel, so a slow channel delays the rest - acceptable here because none of them feed each other.

nodes.name: Append Run Log
nodes.notes: DISABLED until you attach your own credential in n8n. Select the credential, then enable this node.

nodes.notes: DISABLED until you attach your own credential in n8n. Select the credential, then enable this node.

nodes.name: Build Failure Receipt
nodes.notes: Receipt for the failure path. It can receive items from several nodes at once, so it never reads $json - only item.json - and each row carries status FAILED with the error message it saw.
